subject: Context profile and implementation plan — AcmeHealth onboarding
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff notes + high-level asks

Thanks for the kickoff this morning — great to meet the team. A few notes from our side so you have context for implementation planning: 

- Primary use case: automated patient-visit summarization and clinical QA prompts. Outputs are structured (bulleted summary + flagged items).
- Expected peak context needs: up to ~6,000 tokens for aggregated visit + prior notes; worst-case occasionally 8k.
- QPS pattern: bursty during business hours, roughly 80k generation tokens/day and 180k embedding tokens/day across our initial 50 clinics.
- Privacy: PHI will be redacted client-side but we will send de-identified content first. SOC2 / encryption questions will follow.

Can you send a recommended model shortlist and rough token-cost/latency budget so we can align on the mutual action plan? Attaching our initial volume spreadsheet (CSV) for reference.

Thanks,
Lina
Lina Gomez
Head of Clinical AI, Acme Health
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff notes + high-level asks

Thanks Lina — appreciate the clear brief and the CSV. I pulled a fast first-pass shortlist and a couple of follow-ups below. Attaching: acme_token_forecast_q2-q4.csv and a CS implementation checklist.

Shortlist (first pass, tradeoffs noted):
- model-a-13B-8k (recommended starting point): good balance of latency/cost, supports 8k contexts in production; strong instruction-following for structured outputs.
- model-a-33B-16k (for longer-context trials): higher cost but reduces prompt engineering for long visit aggregates.
- model-lite-7B-4k (offline/rate-limited fallback): economical for low-priority summarization where latency tolerates batching.

Questions for sizing:
1) For the 6k typical context, what fraction of requests do you expect to include embedding calls + generation in the same workflow? (That impacts co-located routing vs separate embedding pool).
2) Are there retention requirements where you need the raw prompts/logs stored centrally (we can discuss SOC2 controls and KMS options)?

Action items I propose:
- Marissa: run a throughput/latency estimate for model-a-13B with 6k context (target p95 < 600ms generation token latency).
- Monica: draft a rollout plan with canary cadence and a fallback to model-lite-7B for non-critical batches.
- Stephanie: start the SOC2 evidence sizing thread and pull the encryption questions from Acme's security contact.

Will follow up after we have Marissa's numbers.

— Vivek
VP, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff notes + high-level asks

On Sun, Apr 11, 2027 at 12:03 PM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Shortlist (first pass, tradeoffs noted):
> - model-a-13B-8k (recommended starting point)
> - model-a-33B-16k (for longer-context trials)
> - model-lite-7B-4k (offline/rate-limited fallback)

Quick throughput estimates (very rough until we have a sample prompt and token distribution):
- model-a-13B-8k: with continuous batching tuned for QPS bursts of ~60 req/s, we estimate sustained throughput of ~45 req/s with median latency ~400ms and p95 ~700ms on a 4-GPU dedicated pool. Token cost projection (generation only): ~$0.0025 per 1k gen tokens (customer-visible unit price to be adjusted by pricing tier).
- model-a-33B-16k: expect ~35% higher per-token latency and ~2x per-token cost vs 13B for the same sequence lengths (due to memory and kernel costs).
- model-lite-7B-4k: very economical when batched; effective for background summarization jobs where p95 can be >2s.

I also ran a quick sensitivity: if 30% of requests include embeddings (512-d vectors) in the same transaction, we recommend a separate embedding pool to avoid contention — estimate ~4 dedicated CPUs per 1k embedding qps with batching.

I'll produce a more precise table after we get a 3-5 sample prompts and token histograms from Acme.

— Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmehealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff notes + high-level asks

Hi Lina — thanks for the extra detail and sending the CSV. We reviewed Marissa's throughput notes and sketched an initial rollout plan: 

Rollout (high level):
1) Canary week (staging -> 10% production traffic): start with model-a-13B-8k, sample gating with human-in-the-loop on first 2k summaries/day.
2) Evaluate quality/latency: run A/B with model-a-33B-16k on the 10% pool for longer-context visits (only if average context >10k).
3) Fallbacks: model-lite-7B-4k for batched nightly summarization and cheaper background tasks.

Token-volume estimate (based on CSV and our sensitivity):
- Daily generation tokens (day-of): 80k (median) -> monthly ~2.4M gen tokens.
- Daily embedding tokens: 180k -> monthly ~5.4M embedding tokens.
- Peak monthly (growth buffer x1.5): ~3.6M gen; ~8.1M embed.

SLA and cost notes: we can meet a p95 latency target around 700ms for model-a-13B-8k with Dedicated capacity and 99.9% uptime SLAs as part of the Dedicated onboarding package. I'll open a Dedicated sizing proposal once we confirm weekly patterns.

Next steps / asks:
- Lina: please share 3 representative prompts (short, medium, long) and a tokenized histogram if possible.
- Lina: confirm whether embeddings are served synchronously with generation or batched async (impacts routing).
- Marissa: please produce a compact table (per-model cost and expected p95) to include in the mutual action plan doc by EOD Thu.

I'll book a 30-min follow-up next week to align the rollout timeline and Dedicated sizing proposal.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff notes + high-level asks

Thanks — this all looks good. Confirming: we'll share 3 sample prompts and tokenized histograms by Friday. Embeddings will be synchronous in our initial flow (we compute similarity then call generation), but we can explore async batching for background processing.

Also: Acme requires that any PHI-related evidence for SOC2 be shared via our secure SFTP. Stephanie — can you coordinate with our security team on SFTP endpoints and required artifacts?

Appreciate the clear plan — looking forward to the canary.

— Lina
Head of Clinical AI, Acme Health
